detail.longDescription: I am running into a curious issue where in my VS Code instance I get errors regarding Jest, however I can run npm test in my terminal with no issue. Error I see in VS Code: Cannot find name 'describe'. Do you need to install type definitions for a test runner? Try `npm i --save-dev @types/jest` or `npm i --save-dev @types/mocha` and then add 'jest' or 'mocha' to the types field in your tsconfig. I'm not sure what I have to do to get it to work in VS Code. I have tried the command in my terminal, but doesn't change anything, the package is installed. Here is my package.json file: { "name": "my-app", "version": "0.1.0", "private": true, "scripts": { "dev": "next dev", "build": "next build", "start": "next start", "lint": "next lint", "test": "jest --coverage" }, "dependencies": { "@apollo/server": "^5.5.1", "@as-integrations/next": "^4.1.0", "graphql": "^16.14.2", "graphql-tag": "^2.12.7", "mongodb-memory-server": "^11.2.0", "mongoose": "^9.9.4", "next": "16.3.2", "react": "19.2.8", "react-dom": "19.2.8" }, "devDependencies": { "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4", "@types/jest": "^30.0.0", "@types/node": "^20", "@types/react": "^19", "@types/react-dom": "^19", "eslint": "^9", "eslint-config-next": "16.3.2", "jest": "^30.5.0", "tailwindcss": "^4", "ts-jest": "^29.4.12", "typescript": "^5" } } As you can see, Jest is in my package.json file. I have tried deleting the node_modules folder and the package-lock.json file and rebuilt with npm i and still get the same issue. I've also tried restarting VS Code and installing the Jest extension to no avail. Do you know of any other debug steps I can do to get this to work properly?
